description: Validates that coding-agent consumers use Agent Manager through declared, portable role-based profiles.

capabilities.label: Portable Agent Profiles
capabilities.description: Agent Manager consumers declare non-disabled dependencies, reconcile scenario-owned role-only profiles, resolve portable roles, and keep direct executable spawns behind the platform boundary.

levels.name: Contract missing
levels.description: The target does not declare a non-disabled Agent Manager dependency.
levels.capability_summary: Portable coding-agent ownership is not established.
levels.next_unlock: Declare a non-disabled Agent Manager dependency and portable profile contract.
exit_criteria: Dependency and role-only profiles are declared.

levels.name: Profile integrity
levels.description: Every scenario-owned profile source is declared, readable, owned by the target, and role-only.
levels.capability_summary: Profile ownership is explicit and inspectable.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve every declared roleRef through Agent Manager's role catalog.
exit_criteria: No profile source or ownership errors remain.

levels.name: Portable resolution
levels.description: Every declared roleRef resolves through Agent Manager's resource-owned role catalog.
levels.capability_summary: The target can request coding agents without concrete runner or model policy.
levels.next_unlock: Adopt the Agent Manager spawn boundary for all coding-agent execution.

levels.name: Spawn-boundary adoption
levels.description: The target has no known direct coding-agent executable spawn bypasses.
levels.capability_summary: Portable configuration and spawning follow the platform authority boundary.
levels.next_unlock: Continuously verify the complete contract through the discovered conformance phase.

levels.name: Conformant
levels.description: The target is clean across dependency, profile integrity, portable resolution, and spawn-boundary checks.
levels.capability_summary: The scenario is continuously conformant with Agent Manager-owned portable coding-agent configuration.
exit_criteria: Conformance is continuously verified by Test Genie.

capabilities.label: Classifier Accuracy
capabilities.description: Every shipped friction detector has committed labelled coverage and meets its published precision and recall threshold through the shared deterministic scorer.

levels.name: Unmeasured
levels.description: The labelled corpus or scorer cannot produce a complete result.
levels.next_unlock: Restore the committed labelled corpus and one shared scorer.

levels.name: Measured
levels.description: All shipped detectors have published precision and recall.
levels.next_unlock: Bring every detector to its committed threshold.

levels.name: Threshold met
levels.description: Every detector meets its committed precision and recall threshold.

agent_conformance.dependency_missing.reason: The scenario owner must declare its Agent Manager integration.

agent_conformance.dependency_disabled.reason: A disabled dependency cannot provide a portable spawning contract.

agent_conformance.profile_invalid.reason: Profile files must be repaired by their owning scenario.

agent_conformance.profile_orphan.reason: Every scenario-owned profile file must be declared by its dependency configuration.

agent_conformance.profile_legacy_field.reason: Concrete runner/model inputs violate portable role ownership.

agent_conformance.role_unresolved.reason: Every profile roleRef must resolve through Agent Manager's portable role catalog.

agent_conformance.direct_spawn_bypass.reason: Fleet conformance proved the narrow executable-construction detection has an acceptable false-positive rate; coding-agent spawning must use Agent Manager.

agent_conformance.permission_posture.reason: A consumer cannot be fully conformant while Agent Manager reports unmet required native or hook-backed global permission enforcement.

classifier_accuracy.unmeasured.reason: A phase must not report classifier accuracy when the shared scorer cannot read complete labelled coverage.

classifier_accuracy.coverage_missing.reason: A detector without committed labelled coverage cannot claim measured classifier accuracy.

classifier_accuracy.below_threshold.reason: A detector below its committed precision or recall threshold cannot provide trustworthy friction evidence.
